Only 1 (low-confidence) candidate is recorded rather than fabricating a second to clear the LOW-tier evidence floor -- consistent with the honest-limitation pattern already applied to GHIBLI_04 in this same phase. This dimension will correctly remain below LOW-tier credit for MORI_02 (validateEnvironmentMotionDnaSignal requires >=2 real candidates).
